```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(countrycode)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(shiny)
library(readxl)
library(DT)


knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```


```{r}
studies = read_rds("data/studies.rds")
countries = read_rds("data/countries.rds")
sponsors = read_rds("data/sponsors.rds")
conditions = read_rds("data/conditions.rds")
browse_conditions = read_rds("data/browse_conditions.rds")
browse_interventions = read_rds("data/browse_interventions.rds")
baseline_counts = read_rds("data/baseline_counts.rds")
eligibilities = read_rds("data/eligibilities.rds")
designs = read_rds("data/designs.rds")

trials_df = studies |> 
  mutate(start_year = lubridate::year(start_date)) |> 
  distinct(nct_id, .keep_all=TRUE)
```

```{r}
trials_df = studies |>
  mutate(start_year = lubridate::year(start_date)) |>
  distinct(nct_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Define analysis period
years_keep = 2019:2023

selected_studies = trials_df |>
  filter(start_year %in% years_keep) |>
  distinct(nct_id)

# Load Sanyu's prepared data
trial_cause_df = read_rds("data/tidy/trial_cause.rds")
trial_terms_df = read_rds("data/tidy/trial_terms.rds")
gbd_df = read_rds("data/tidy/daly.rds")

# Trials with at least one condition MeSH term
mesh_ids = trial_terms_df |>
  semi_join(selected_studies, by = "nct_id") |>
  distinct(nct_id)

# Trial-to-GBD disease classifications
study_disease = trial_cause_df |>
  semi_join(selected_studies, by = "nct_id") |>
  transmute(
    nct_id,
    analysis_cause_id,
    disease_category = analysis_cause
  ) |>
  distinct()

# All GBD analysis categories
disease_categories = gbd_df |>
  filter(year == 2023) |>
  distinct(analysis_cause) |>
  pull(analysis_cause)
```


# Number of unique studies per country

```{r}
studies_by_country = countries |>
  semi_join(studies, by = "nct_id") |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_studies))

# View top 20 countries
studies_by_country |>
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

# Countries With the Most Registered Clinical Trials

```{r}
studies_by_country |>
  slice_max(n_studies, n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = n_studies,
    y = reorder(country, n_studies)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Countries With the Most Registered Clinical Studies",
    subtitle = "ClinicalTrials.gov / AACT",
    x = "Number of unique registered studies",
    y = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# Clinical Research Activity Over Time

```{r}
studies_by_year = studies |>
  mutate(year = year(start_date)) |>
  filter(between(year, 2010, 2025)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

studies_by_year |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_studies)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2010:2025) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Clinical Research Activity Over Time",
    subtitle = "Registered trials, 2010–2025",
    x = "Study start year",
    y = "Number of studies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# Combine country information with broad MeSH categories

```{r}

# One row per study-country, 2019–2023
study_country = countries |>
  semi_join(selected_studies, by = "nct_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(country), country != "") |>
  distinct(nct_id, country)

# Only studies with condition MeSH terms
eligible_studies = study_country |>
  semi_join(mesh_ids, by = "nct_id")

# Combine country and disease
study_country_disease = eligible_studies |>
  inner_join(
    study_disease,
    by = "nct_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  distinct(nct_id, country, disease_category)

# Country denominators
country_totals = eligible_studies |>
  count(country, name = "n_eligible")

country_classified = study_country_disease |>
  distinct(nct_id, country) |>
  count(country, name = "n_classified")

# Country-disease counts and proportions
country_disease = study_country_disease |>
  count(country, disease_category, name = "n_studies") |>
  left_join(country_totals, by = "country") |>
  left_join(country_classified, by = "country") |>
  mutate(
    pct_studies = 100 * n_studies / n_eligible,
    pct_classified = 100 * n_studies / n_classified
  )

```

## Which diseases are studied most in each country?

```{r}

top_diseases_by_country = country_disease |>
  group_by(country) |>
  slice_max(n_studies, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(country, desc(n_studies)) |>
  ungroup()

top_diseases_by_country |>
  select(country, disease_category, n_studies, pct_studies)


# Top 20 countries by overall number of studies
top_20_countries = country_totals |>
  slice_max(n_eligible, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  pull(country)

# Top 10 disease categories globally
top_10_diseases = study_disease |>
  semi_join(selected_studies, by = "nct_id") |>
  count(disease_category, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  pull(disease_category)

# Prepare heatmap
heatmap_df = country_disease |>
  filter(
    country %in% top_20_countries,
    disease_category %in% top_10_diseases
  )

# Plot
heatmap_df |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = disease_category,
    y = forcats::fct_reorder(country, n_eligible),
    fill = pct_studies
  )) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "% of studies"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Disease-Specific Clinical Research Across Countries",
    subtitle = "Top 20 countries and 10 most common disease categories",
    x = "Disease category",
    y = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

```

# Interactive map!!!

```{r clinical-trial-explorer, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. PREPARE MAP AND DISEASE DATA

# One row per study-country
trial_countries = countries |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country, "country.name", "iso3c"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country_iso3)) |>
  distinct(nct_id, country_iso3)

study_country_map = selected_studies |>
  inner_join(trial_countries, by = "nct_id") |>
  distinct(nct_id, country_iso3)

# Count unique studies by country
country_counts = study_country_map |>
  group_by(country_iso3) |>
  summarise(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Map data: annual studies per million residents
map_df = country_counts |>
  mutate(
    country_name = countrycode(
      country_iso3,
      "iso3c",
      "country.name"
    )
  )

# Broad disease classifications
study_diseases = study_disease |>
  select(nct_id, disease_category)


# Trials with condition MeSH classifications
study_country_mesh = study_country_map |>
  semi_join(mesh_ids, by = "nct_id")

# Denominator for disease percentages
country_mesh_counts = study_country_mesh |>
  count(country_iso3, name = "n_eligible")

# Disease-specific counts and percentages
country_diseases = study_country_mesh |>
  inner_join(
    study_diseases,
    by = "nct_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  distinct(nct_id, country_iso3, disease_category) |>
  count(
    country_iso3,
    disease_category,
    name = "n_category"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    country_mesh_counts,
    by = "country_iso3"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_studies = 100 * n_category / n_eligible
  )

# =====================================================
# 2. USER INTERFACE
# =====================================================

ui = fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Global Clinical Research Explorer"),

  fluidRow(

    column(
      7,
      h4("Registered interventional trials, 2019–2023"),
      plotlyOutput("world_map", height = "600px")
    ),

    column(
      5,
      h4(textOutput("country_title")),
      plotlyOutput("disease_plot", height = "650px")
    )

  ),

  hr(),

  fluidRow(
    column(
      12,
      h4(textOutput("studies_heading")),
      DTOutput("studies_table"),
      br(),
      p(
        "Dates describe the overall registered study,",
        "not necessarily its activities within the",
        "selected country. Completion dates may be",
        "actual or estimated."
      )
    )
  )

)


# =====================================================
# 3. SERVER
# =====================================================

server = function(input, output, session) {

  # Default to USA, if available
  default_country = if (
    "USA" %in% map_df$country_iso3
  ) {
    "USA"
  } else {
    map_df$country_iso3[1]
  }

  selected_country = reactiveVal(default_country)
  selected_disease = reactiveVal(NULL)


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # A. INTERACTIVE WORLD MAP
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  output$world_map = renderPlotly({

    p = plot_ly(
      data = map_df,
      type = "choropleth",
      locations = ~country_iso3,
      locationmode = "ISO-3",
      z = ~n_studies,
      key = ~country_iso3,
      source = "world",
      text = ~paste0(
        country_name,
        "<br>Registered trials: ",
        scales::comma(n_studies)
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text",
      colorscale = "Viridis"
    ) |>
      layout(
        geo = list(
          showframe = FALSE,
          showcoastlines = FALSE,
          projection = list(type = "natural earth")
        )
      )

    event_register(p, "plotly_click")
  })


  # Detect country clicks
  observeEvent(
    event_data(
      "plotly_click",
      source = "world",
      priority = "event"
    ),
    {
      clicked = event_data(
        "plotly_click",
        source = "world"
      )

      req(nrow(clicked) > 0)

      code = if ("key" %in% names(clicked)) {
        as.character(clicked$key[1])
      } else if ("location" %in% names(clicked)) {
        as.character(clicked$location[1])
      } else {
        NULL
      }

      req(
        !is.null(code),
        code %in% map_df$country_iso3
      )

      selected_country(code)
    }
  )


  # Clear disease when selecting a new country
  observeEvent(
    selected_country(),
    {
      selected_disease(NULL)
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )


  # Country heading
  output$country_title = renderText({

    country_name = countrycode(
      selected_country(),
      "iso3c",
      "country.name"
    )

    paste("Disease research profile:", country_name)
  })


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # B. CLICKABLE DISEASE BAR CHART
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  output$disease_plot = renderPlotly({

    d = country_diseases |>
      filter(country_iso3 == selected_country()) |>
      arrange(pct_studies) |>
      mutate(
        disease_label = factor(
          disease_category,
          levels = disease_category
        )
      )

    validate(
      need(nrow(d) > 0, "No classified studies available")
    )

    p = plot_ly(
      data = d,
      x = ~pct_studies,
      y = ~disease_label,
      key = ~disease_category,
      source = "disease",
      type = "bar",
      orientation = "h",
      text = ~paste0(
        round(pct_studies, 1), "%",
        "<br>", scales::comma(n_category),
        " studies",
        "<br>Click to see studies"
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text"
    ) |>
      layout(
        xaxis = list(
          title = "% of MeSH-indexed intervational trials",
          range = c(0, 100)
        ),
        yaxis = list(
          title = "",
          automargin = TRUE
        ),
        margin = list(l = 260, r = 20)
      )

    event_register(p, "plotly_click")
  })


  # Detect disease category clicks
  observeEvent(
    event_data(
      "plotly_click",
      source = "disease",
      priority = "event"
    ),
    {
      clicked = event_data(
        "plotly_click",
        source = "disease"
      )

      req(nrow(clicked) > 0)

      disease = if ("key" %in% names(clicked)) {
        as.character(clicked$key[1])
      } else if ("y" %in% names(clicked)) {
        as.character(clicked$y[1])
      } else {
        NULL
      }

      available = country_diseases |>
        filter(country_iso3 == selected_country()) |>
        pull(disease_category)

      req(
        !is.null(disease),
        disease %in% available
      )

      selected_disease(disease)
    }
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # C. GET INDIVIDUAL STUDIES
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  # Only retrieve details for selected country/disease
  study_details = reactive({

    req(selected_country(), selected_disease())

    matching_ids = study_country_map |>
      filter(country_iso3 == selected_country()) |>
      semi_join(
        study_diseases |>
          filter(
            disease_category == selected_disease()
          ),
        by = "nct_id"
      ) |>
      distinct(nct_id)

    matching_ids |>
      left_join(
        trials_df |>
          select(
            nct_id,
            brief_title,
            study_type,
            start_date,
            completion_date,
            overall_status
          ),
        by = "nct_id",
        relationship = "many-to-one"
      ) |>
      mutate(
        start_date = as.Date(start_date),
        completion_date = as.Date(completion_date),
        duration_months = if_else(
          !is.na(start_date) &
            !is.na(completion_date) &
            completion_date >= start_date,
          round(
            as.numeric(
              completion_date - start_date
            ) / 30.44,
            1
          ),
          NA_real_
        )
      )
  })


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # D. STUDY TABLE HEADING
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  output$studies_heading = renderText({

    if (is.null(selected_disease())) {
      return(
        "Click a disease category to view individual studies"
      )
    }

    country_name = countrycode(
      selected_country(),
      "iso3c",
      "country.name"
    )

    paste0(
      "Studies in ", country_name,
      " — ", selected_disease(),
      " (", scales::comma(nrow(study_details())),
      " studies)"
    )
  })


  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # E. SEARCHABLE STUDY TABLE
  # ---------------------------------------------------

  output$studies_table = DT::renderDT({

    req(selected_disease())

    d = study_details() |>
      arrange(desc(start_date)) |>
      transmute(
        `NCT ID` = nct_id,
        `Study title` = coalesce(
          brief_title, "Title unavailable"
        ),
        `Study type` = study_type,
        `Start date` = as.character(start_date),
        `Completion date` = as.character(completion_date),
        `Reported interval (months)` = duration_months,
        `Status` = overall_status
      )

    # Clickable study titles
    d$`Study title` = paste0(
      '<a href="https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/',
      d$`NCT ID`,
      '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(d$`Study title`),
      '</a>'
    )

    DT::datatable(
      d,
      rownames = FALSE,
      filter = "top",
      escape = which(names(d) != "Study title"),
      options = list(
        pageLength = 10,
        lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50),
        scrollX = TRUE
      )
    )

  }, server = TRUE)

}


# =====================================================
# 4. LAUNCH APP
# =====================================================

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```


# Seeing whether certain countries have a greater research focus on certain diseases:

```{r}

# Count studies in each country-disease category
country_disease_counts = eligible_studies |>
  inner_join(
    study_disease,
    by = "nct_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  distinct(nct_id, country, disease_category) |>
  count(
    country,
    disease_category,
    name = "n_category"
  )

# Include zero counts for absent disease categories
country_disease_full = tidyr::crossing(
  country_totals,
  disease_category = disease_categories
) |>
  left_join(
    country_disease_counts,
    by = c("country", "disease_category")
  ) |>
  mutate(n_category = replace_na(n_category, 0L))


# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. Calculate enrichment compared with
#    all other country-study records
# ------------------------------------------------

total_eligible = sum(country_totals$n_eligible)

global_disease_counts = country_disease_full |>
  group_by(disease_category) |>
  summarise(
    global_n = sum(n_category),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

enrichment_df = country_disease_full |>
  left_join(
    global_disease_counts,
    by = "disease_category"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Country's percentage
    pct_country = 100 * n_category / n_eligible,

    # Percentage among other country-study records
    n_other = total_eligible - n_eligible,
    disease_other = global_n - n_category,
    pct_other = 100 * disease_other / n_other,

    # Relative enrichment
    enrichment = if_else(
      pct_other > 0,
      pct_country / pct_other,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Absolute difference
    pct_point_diff = pct_country - pct_other,

    # Expected number at the comparator percentage
    expected_n = n_eligible * pct_other / 100
  )


enrichment_df |>
  filter(
    country == "Ghana",
    disease_category == "eye diseases"
  ) |>
  select(
    country,
    disease_category,
    n_eligible,
    n_category,
    pct_country,
    pct_other,
    enrichment,
    pct_point_diff,
    expected_n
  ) |>
  print()

top_enrichments = enrichment_df |>
  filter(
    n_eligible >= 100,
    n_category >= 10,
    expected_n >= 5,
    is.finite(enrichment)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(enrichment)) |>
  select(
    country,
    disease_category,
    n_category,
    n_eligible,
    pct_country,
    pct_other,
    enrichment,
    pct_point_diff
  )

top_enrichments |>
  slice_head(n = 30)

top_enrichments |>
  group_by(country) |>
  slice_max(enrichment, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(enrichment))
```
